Name: Backwoods Extra Area
Author: tikamin557
Description:
If you are using this mod at the same time as other mods that overlap with the edit position of Backwoods, please enable "Repositioning of entrances" in the ModConfig settings.
The entrance to the ExtraArea will be changed to the top right of Backwoods.
If the edit position still overlaps, please submit a compatibility request on the POSTS page.

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Mods currently adding compatibility individually.[/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/url]
You can turn it on and off in the settings.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24852]Coal Point Farm - Custom NPCs[/url]


Currently, English, Japanese and French are supported.
